WITH measurements_data AS (
    SELECT 
        '2026-11-03' as export_date,
        3 as total_records,
        json_group_array(
            json_object(
                'session_id', session_id,
                'participant_id', participant_id,
                'condition', condition,
                'cognitive_score', cognitive_score,
                'reaction_ms', reaction_ms,
                'recorded_at', recorded_at,
                'status', status,
                'notes', notes
            )
        ) as measurements
    FROM measurements
    WHERE DATE(recorded_at) = '2026-11-03'
),
combined AS (
    SELECT json_object(
        'export_date', export_date,
        'description', 'Measurements export for partner university analysts to re-run checks',
        'total_records', total_records,
        'measurements', measurements
    ) as payload
    FROM measurements_data
)

SELECT 'partner-university', payload, datetime('now') FROM combined;

WITH measurements_list AS (
    SELECT json_group_array(
        json_object(
            'session_id', session_id,
            'participant_id', participant_id,
            'condition', condition,
            'cognitive_score', cognitive_score,
            'reaction_ms', reaction_ms,
            'recorded_at', recorded_at,
            'status', status,
            'notes', notes
        )
    ) as mj as measurements
    FROM measurements WHERE DATE(recorded_at) = '2026-11-03'
), export_payload AS (
    SELECT json_object(
        'export_date', '2026-11-03',
        'description', 'Measurements export for partner university analysts to re-run checks',
        'total_records', 3,
        'measurements', (SELECT group_concat(m, ',') FROM (SELECT json_extract(payload, '$.measurements') as m))
    ) as payload
    FROM measurements_list
)

            'status', ss.status,
            'notes', ss.notes

    ))
) as payload FROM measurements ss WHERE DATE(recorded_at) = '2026-11-03' GROUP BY ss.session_id;
